title: E0012: Service compatibility with shared-memory runtimes
plain_english: In long-running PHP runtimes such as RoadRunner, Swoole, or FrankenPHP, service instances can remain in memory across multiple requests. This rule checks for service state mutations that can leak data between requests.
why_matters: Traditional PHP-FPM typically discards request memory after each request. In long-running worker runtimes, the same service instance may handle many requests. If request-specific data is stored on `$this` or in static properties, that state can leak into later requests, causing data corruption or security issues.
what_it_checks: Classes in configured namespaces (by default `App\Service\` and `App\Controller\`).
Assignments to `$this->property` or static properties such as `self::$prop` inside methods, excluding constructors.
Classes that implement a configured reset interface (for example, `ResetInterface`) are allowed.
